questions.stem: A transformer has 200 turns on the primary coil and 50 turns on the secondary coil. What type of transformer is this?

options.text: It depends on the input voltage

questions.explanation: This is a step-down transformer because the secondary coil has fewer turns than the primary coil (50 < 200). The turns ratio is 4:1, meaning the output voltage will be one quarter of the input voltage.
